debt.description: Lord Abbett borrower debt rows: explicit srt:OwnershipAxis members humanised as '<issuer> Term Loan|Delayed Draw|Revolver|Incremental ...' (optionally followed by a vintage year, lot ordinal, amendment label or currency), plus the older typed-axis '<issuer> (Revolver)' / '(Delayed Draw)' rows.

equity.description: Equity rows only when an identifier includes explicit position-level equity security text; member and total rows are rollups.

known_edge_cases.description: The 2025-12-31 and 2026-03-31 filings include InvestmentIdentifierAxis facts such as First Lien Secured Debt [Member] and Equity [Member]. These are category/member rollups, not position-level constituents.

Total investments, total first/second lien debt, total equity, and total joint venture rows are portfolio rollups that should be documented for reconciliation but not promoted to position-level holdings.
known_edge_cases.detection_pattern: Total Investments at Fair Value / Total First Lien Secured Debt-non-controlled/non-affiliated

known_edge_cases.description: Typed InvestmentIdentifierAxis rows such as '<issuer>, Inc. (Revolver)' / '(Delayed Draw)' (2024-12-31 through 2025-09-30) carry commitment text but blank fair value in the cached XBRL. The wrapper recognizes the identifier shape but does not synthesize missing FV. From 2025-12-31 the filer moved to explicit srt:OwnershipAxis members and these typed rows stop.

Wrapper v2 (2026-09-15). Positions are explicit srt:OwnershipAxis members (extension namespace lordabbett.com) humanised by pipeline.explicit_contexts as '<issuer> Term Loan' / 'Delayed Draw' / 'Revolver' / 'Incremental ...', optionally followed by a vintage year ('Delayed Draw 2024'), a lot ordinal ('Delayed Draw 1'), an amendment label ('Term Loan 20252 nd Amendment' is the humaniser's rendering of '2025 2nd Amendment') or a currency ('Term Loan 2025 USD/EUR/AUD'). The second fallback_family_patterns entry routes any identifier with an issuer stem followed by one of these tokens to the debt family, and 'term loan' / 'incremental' were added to leaf_markers_by_family.debt so they classify as debt_position_leaf. JV look-through rows share this shape and carry investmentcompanynonconsolidatedsubsidiaryaxis in dimensions_raw (retain-and-flag, not aggregates).

Wrapper v2 (2026-09-15). Trailing years and lot ordinals denote distinct coexisting positions, not volatile decoration: e.g. 'RSC Acquisition Inc Delayed Draw', '... Delayed Draw 1' and '... Delayed Draw 2' all exist in 2024-12-31; 'RJW Logistics Group Inc Term Loan 2024' and '... Term Loan 2025' coexist from 2025-12-31. The v1 canonical_strip_re '\s+\d+\s*$' collapsed 20 such same-quarter groups into one position key, so it was removed. Cross-quarter renames (e.g. 'Applied Aerospace Structures Corp Delayed Draw' split into 'Delayed Draw 2024' + 'Delayed Draw 2025' at 2025-12-31) are genuine taxonomy re-cuts and are left to the position matcher.

Bare '<issuer>' members without a tranche token (e.g. 'BCM One Inc', 'Transnet YX Inc', 'Vensure Employer Services Inc', 'GCOM', 'Databricks Inc') appear as own-book rows in the 2024-09-30, 2024-12-31 and 2025-03-31 filings (a few persist to 2025-09-30) and as JV look-through comparatives. They carry interest_rate and maturity_date, i.e. they are the term loans before the filer added 'Term Loan' to the member name; later filings restate the same period under '<issuer> Term Loan'. The wrapper deliberately leaves them uncovered (no family): routing them through a bare-name fallback would classify them as debt_issuer_rollup, which source reconciliation excuses as an issuer-level subtotal and would hide real positions. They remain visible as unclassified source rows.
known_edge_cases.detection_pattern: ^<issuer entity name>$ with interest_rate and maturity_date populated

known_edge_cases.description: 'Arkas Bidco Limited' and 'Arkas Bidco Limited Two' (2025-12-31; industry axis 'Personal Care Products Equity'; FV 888,000 and 2,000) are equity positions whose member names carry no instrument text. They are left uncovered for the same reason as the bare debt members (issuer_rollup would excuse them). Candidate for a same-accession HTML-section bridge (docs/wrapper/WRAPPER_PROFILE.md step 1f) rather than a name-specific wrapper rule.
known_edge_cases.detection_pattern: Arkas Bidco Limited / Arkas Bidco Limited Two

known_edge_cases.description: Two filer tagging quirks put the position member on the industry axis: 'Commercial Services Supplies' (2025-12-31, two rows, FV 379,000 and 308,000) carries 'Ambient Enterprises Holdco LLC Term Loan 2025 2nd/3rd Amendment' as its industry, and 'Databricks Inc' (2025-06-30, 2025-09-30) carries 'Databricks Inc Term Loan' as its industry. The wrapper classifies identifier text only and cannot repair the swap; a fix belongs in pipeline.explicit_contexts, not here.
known_edge_cases.detection_pattern: ownershipaxis member is an industry label while equitysecuritiesbyindustryaxis member ends in Term Loan

known_edge_cases.description: 'SBLA Private Credit LLC' (industry 'Investments In Joint Venture') is the fund's own JV interest and a real position (FV 33.2m at 2024-12-31 rising to 64.2m at 2026-03-31). It must not be added to aggregate_markers; only the 'Total Investments in Joint Venture' rollup is an aggregate. The identifier has no instrument token so it stays uncovered by dispatch.
